title: The Scorched Knight
text: A knight in fire-blackened armor sits by the road, his plates fused together, his visor welded shut. He is still alive inside; you can hear him breathing, and smell him. He went to slay a dragon, he rasps.

options.label: Pry him out of the fused armor, however long it takes.

outcomes.text: It takes hours, and what comes out is raw and red. He will live. He gives you his sword.

options.label: The wisest asks him about the dragon while he can still speak.

outcomes.text: Through the visor slit he rasps where it sleeps and which side it favors.

options.label: The Leader takes his armor; he will not need it where he is going.

outcomes.text: The steel is good, cut off him piece by piece. He curses you as you go, and means every word.
